description: SDI2019: ZIP Code Tabulation Area (ZCTA) → Social Deprivation Index decile (1-10). Source: Robert Graham Center 2019 SDI at ZCTA (2015-2019 ACS 5-year estimates). Prefer OverrideZipCode already normalized to 5 digits (digits-only; ZIP+4 stripped). Chart postalCode handling is best-effort (hyphen strip + pad). The Angular calculator resolves live ZIP→SDI via this
